items.heading: Potjiekos
details: Key ingredients: beef or game meat, vegetables, wine
Brown meat in a cast-iron pot over an open fire.
Layer vegetables on top without stirring.
Add a splash of wine or stock, then cover.
Simmer slowly over coals for hours until everything is tender.

items.heading: Kapana
details: Key ingredients: beef, chili, salt
Slice beef into thin strips.
Grill quickly over very high heat on an open flat grill.
Season simply with salt and chili powder.
Serve immediately, often chopped and dipped in extra chili.

items.heading: Oshifima
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
